fields.contract:
ArgentSea.LoggingExtensions is a static high-performance logging helper class built on LoggerMessage.Define and LoggerMessage.DefineScope. Every extension method accepts a nullable ILogger? receiver and is a no-op when logger is null:

1. EventIdentifier enum:
   - ConnectionStringBuilt = 0
   - ExpressionTreeCreation = 1
   - MapperSqlParameterNotFound = 2
   - MapperSqlColumnNotFound = 3
   - MapperCacheStatus = 4
   - MapperProcessTrace = 5
   - UnexpectedDbNull = 6
   - MapperResultsReaderInvalid = 7
   - CmdExecuted = 8
   - ConnectRetry = 9
   - CommandRetry = 10
   - CircuitBreaker = 11
   - BatchStep = 12

2. Connection & Command Execution / Scope Methods:
   - SqlConnectionStringBuilt(this ILogger? logger, string connectionString): Debug, EventIdentifier.ConnectionStringBuilt (0).
   - BuildSqlResultsHandlerScope(this ILogger? logger, string procedureName, Type model) -> IDisposable?: opens a logical scope via LoggerMessage.DefineScope<string, Type> ("Build logic to convert sql procedure {name} results to result {type}").
   - TraceDbCmdExecuted(this ILogger? logger, string commandName, string connectionName, long milliseconds): Trace (guarded by logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace)), EventIdentifier.CmdExecuted (8).
   - TraceShardCmdExecuted(this ILogger? logger, string commandName, string shardSetKey, short shardId, long milliseconds): Trace (guarded by logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace)), EventIdentifier.CmdExecuted (8), formatting shardId.ToString().
   - internal BatchStepStart(this ILogger? logger, int stepIndex, string connectionName) and internal BatchStepEnd(this ILogger? logger, int stepIndex, string connectionName): Debug, EventIdentifier.BatchStep (12).

3. Mapping Cache Status Methods (EventIdentifier.MapperCacheStatus = 4):
   - Misses (LogLevel.Debug): SqlInParametersCacheMiss(ILogger?, Type TModel), SqlSetOutParametersCacheMiss(ILogger?, Type TModel), SqlReadOutParametersCacheMiss(ILogger?, Type TModel), SqlReaderCacheMiss(ILogger?, Type TModel).
   - Hits (LogLevel.Trace): SqlInParametersCacheHit(ILogger?, Type TModel), SqlSetOutParametersCacheHit(ILogger?, Type TModel), SqlReadOutParametersCacheHit(ILogger?, Type TModel), SqlReaderCacheHit(ILogger?, Type TModel).

4. Per-Property Mapping Trace Methods (LogLevel.Trace, EventIdentifier.MapperProcessTrace = 5):
   - TraceInMapperProperty(ILogger?, string propertyName)
   - TraceSetOutMapperProperty(ILogger?, string propertyName)
   - TraceGetOutMapperProperty(ILogger?, string propertyName)
   - TraceRdrMapperProperty(ILogger?, string propertyName)

5. Missing Parameter/Column, Null, and Reader-State Methods:
   - SqlParameterNotFound(ILogger?, string parameterName, Type propertyType): Debug, EventIdentifier.MapperSqlParameterNotFound (2).
   - SqlFieldNotFound(ILogger?, string columnName, string modelName): Debug, EventIdentifier.MapperSqlColumnNotFound (3).
   - RequiredPropertyIsDbNull(ILogger?, string modelName, string parameterName): Debug, EventIdentifier.UnexpectedDbNull (6).
   - EmptyResult(ILogger?, string queryName): Debug, EventIdentifier.UnexpectedDbNull (6).
   - NullShardChildArguments<TRecord, TChild>(ILogger?, string propertyName, ShardKey<TRecord, TChild> shardChild): Information (guarded by logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information) && (shardChild.RecordId is null || shardChild.ChildId is null)), EventIdentifier.UnexpectedDbNull (6).
   - DataReaderIsNull(ILogger?, string sprocName, string connectionName) and DataReaderIsClosed(ILogger?, string sprocName, string connectionName): Error, EventIdentifier.MapperResultsReaderInvalid (7).

6. Compiled Expression-Tree Diagnostic Methods (LogLevel.Debug, EventIdentifier.ExpressionTreeCreation = 1, each guarded by logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug) before rendering via DebugViewWriter.WriteTo):
   - CreatedExpressionTreeForSetInParameters(ILogger?, Type model, Expression codeBlock)
   - CreatedExpressionTreeForSetOutParameters(ILogger?, Type model, Expression codeBlock)
   - CreatedExpressionTreeForReadOutParameters(ILogger?, Type model, Expression codeBlock)
   - CreatedExpressionTreeForReaderOrdinals(ILogger?, Type model, Expression codeBlock)
   - CreatedExpressionTreeForReaderRowData(ILogger?, Type model, Expression codeBlock)
   - CreatedExpressionTreeForModel(ILogger?, Type model, string procedureName, Expression codeBlock)

7. Resilience Methods (defined on LoggingExtensions using EventIdentifier.ConnectRetry = 9 and EventIdentifier.CircuitBreaker = 11):
   - RetryingDbConnection(ILogger?, string connectionName, int attemptCount, Exception exception)
   - CiruitBreakingDbConnection, CiruitBreakingDbCommand, CiruitBrokenDbConnectionTest, CiruitBrokenDbCommandTest, CiruitBrokenDbConnectionRestored, CiruitBrokenDbCommandRestored.
fields.name: LoggingExtensions and EventIdentifier structured logging surface
